segments.comment: sys/unix/unixmain.c attempt_restore: Alice walks three squares and saves to save/<uid>Alice (files.c set_savefile_name()).
Debug mode: options.c set_playmode() renames the hero 'wizard' before attempt_restore, so C looks for save/<uid>wizard, finds none and starts a new game.
Alice in normal mode again: her save is untouched, so C restores it.
